newsitem.title: DUBAI: Dubai executes man for rape, murder of young girl.
newsitem.headline: Dubai executes man for rape, murder of young girl.

text.p: Dubai has executed a United Arab Emirates (UAE) man for kidnapping, raping and killing a seven-year-old girl, newspapers reported on Wednesday.
They quoted a statement by the public prosecutor as saying Khalid Mohammad Moussaji, who the papers said was a 40-year-old father of 16 children, was executed by firing squad on Tuesday.
The court had sentenced Moussaji's brother-in-law to life imprisonment for "assisting and keeping silent about" the 1995 kidnap and murder of the girl, identified only as Amina.
The UAE has enforced the death sentence for crimes such as rape, murder and drug smuggling. Executions are usually carried out by firing squad.
